en: Sepia-toned postcard-style photograph of a coastal town and harbor. In the foreground is a simple wooden pier or jetty extending over shallow water with rocks and sand on the shore. Across the bay lies a densely built hillside town with low, traditional houses. Numerous small boats and wooden harbor structures line the waterfront. The image is bordered by a light frame, mounted on a darker card. Handwritten text appears under the photo on the mount, and there is a small printed or stamped monogram in the lower left corner and a signature-like mark in the lower right.
